decision_rule: Two or more of the three probe windows 140, 200 and 280, under the character-count labelling, clearing rank 10 or better of 200 is TWO_OR_MORE_WINDOWS_CLEARED. That enters the earlier rung's invariance fork. One window or none is FEWER_THAN_TWO_WINDOWS_CLEARED.
metric: Count of the three probe windows whose character-count labelling cleared rank 10 or better of 200, against two or more.
notes: Two or more clearing windows enter the earlier rung's fork, and a fixed period there would reopen the training-checkpoint sweep as a question. Any such sweep would be its own seed with its own gate, which this rung neither runs nor prejudges. The largest power ranges over whole cycle counts of two or more only, each with a period of 4 or more in the labelling's own units. That is this rung's one committed change. The one-cycle bin is computed and saved in every spectrum, observed and shuffled alike, and can never be the statistic. After the fixed degree-2 detrend that bin measures the profile's leftover curvature, so a single smooth drop across a window lands there, and such a drop is not a repeating pattern. If the floor gate recorded in these values failed, this record is void as evidence about the model, and is an instrument fault only. A further run of this script on the same box is a rerun of the same instrument, not a replication.
